children: GSK plc Sponsored ADR (LSE:GSK) is bulking up oncology via acquisitions and R&D—buying Nuvalent for $10.6B, wins like Blenrep approval and promising risvutatug/rezetecan and Jideytro data, plus trispecific and TCE programs—while trading at a valuation discount to peers.
Previous Week Recap
GSK Risvutatug Phase III Data
: GSK’s risvutatug rezetecan Phase III China data in relapsed small‑cell lung cancer: OS 18.5 vs 10.3 months (HR 0.46); PFS 7.2 vs 3.0 months; ORR 58.3% vs 12.6%.
GSK Acquired Nuvalent Pipeline
: GSK acquired Nuvalent, gaining neladalkib, zidesamtinib (Jideytro) for ROS1‑positive NSCLC, and its pipeline. Jideytro approved in July; GSK plans Q4 filing for first‑line ROS1 TKI‑naive NSCLC.
GSK Buy Nuvalent For $10.6B
: GSK (GSK) agreed to buy Nuvalent for $10.6B to boost its oncology portfolio; deal announced earlier this year.
GSK plc Sponsored ADR Update
: GSK plc Sponsored ADR (GSK): clinical update says 90% of patients progression-free at 12 months; median PFS not reached. No patient counts, trial phase, indication, or timeline given.
GSK Acquired Trispecific T‑cell Engager
: GSK acquired full global rights to a trispecific T‑cell engager from Chimagen for up to $750M. GSK will start Phase I in 2027 for multiple myeloma; trispecific binds T cells and two tumor antigens.
Blenrep FDA Approval Restores Access
: FDA approved GSK's blood cancer drug Blenrep in October 2025 for use in a combination regimen, restoring U.S. market access after nearly three years of withdrawal.
GSK Expands Oncology Portfolio
: GSK (GSK) expanded oncology via R&D and buys. Key assets: B7-H3, B7-H4, neladalkib, zidesamtinib. Programs target hematologic, gynecologic, lung, GI, prostate cancers. Neladalkib awaiting review.
GSK Myeloma TCE Program
: GSK is advancing a multiple myeloma program aimed at improving tolerability and efficacy of TCE therapies for this noncurative blood cancer; development focuses on enhancing TCE treatment profiles.
GSK Trades At 9.6x 2027 EPS
: GSK (Sponsored ADR) trades near 9.6x 2027 EPS, below European peers' 12.4x, about 22% EV-to-NPV discount. Note cites cost cuts and potential margin stabilization.
